title: Meeting the CBK Cyber and Operational Resilience Framework (CORF) Requirements With Picus
content_md: What is the CBK Cyber and Operational Resilience Framework (CORF)? The CBK Cyber and Operational Resilience Framework, or CORF , is the cybersecurity and resilience regulation that the Central Bank of Kuwait (CBK) issued for the banks and financial institutions it supervises.
